# SwiftUI Motion Library

> 33 copy-paste SwiftUI motion effects (text, buttons, cards, shapes, loaders, backgrounds, particles and 3D) as small, dependency-free views and modifiers. Effects with large or looping motion respect Reduce Motion.

Use the library API instead of hand-writing these animations. Install with Swift Package Manager:

```swift
// Package.swift
.package(url: "https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library", branch: "main")
// target dependencies
.product(name: "MotionLibrary", package: "SwiftUI-Motion-Library")
```

Then `import MotionLibrary`. Requires iOS 17, macOS 14 or visionOS 1; effects marked iOS 18+ are `@available(iOS 18, macOS 15, visionOS 2, *)`.

## Text

- [Typewriter](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/TypewriterText.swift): Characters appear one by one with a blinking cursor. API: `TypewriterText("…")`. Trigger: Appear / Value change.
- [Scramble / Decode](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/ScrambleText.swift): Random glyphs resolve into the real text from left to right. API: `ScrambleText("…")`. Trigger: Appear / Value change.
- [Shimmer](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/Shimmer.swift): A band of light sweeps across text or skeleton placeholders. API: `.shimmer()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Gradient Sweep](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/GradientSweep.swift): A multi-colour gradient flows through the letters forever. API: `.gradientSweep()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Blur-in Words](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/BlurInText.swift): Words come into focus one after another: fade, rise and un-blur. API: `BlurInText("…")`. Trigger: Appear / Value change.
- [Marquee](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/MarqueeText.swift): Text too long for its line scrolls sideways forever, with faded edges. API: `MarqueeText("…")`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Wave Text](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/WaveText.swift): Letters bob in a travelling wave, drawn with a TextRenderer. API: `WaveText("…")`. Trigger: Loop. Requires iOS 18+.

## Button

- [Pressable](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/PressableButtonStyle.swift): Button squashes and darkens on press, then springs back with a light haptic. API: `.buttonStyle(.pressable)`. Trigger: Press.
- [Tap Ripple](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/Ripple.swift): A circular ripple expands from the exact tap location. API: `.ripple()`. Trigger: Tap.
- [Error Shake](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/Shake.swift): Horizontal "no" shake for wrong input, triggered by a value change. API: `.shake(trigger:)`. Trigger: Value change.
- [Magnetic Button](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/Magnetic.swift): The button drifts toward a nearby pointer or dragging finger, then springs home. API: `.magnetic()`. Trigger: Hover / Drag.
- [Hold to Confirm](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/HoldToConfirmButton.swift): Liquid fills the button while you hold; the action runs only when it's full. API: `HoldToConfirmButton("…") { }`. Trigger: Press.
- [Loading → Success](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/StatusButton.swift): The button morphs into a spinner, then a green checkmark or a red shake. API: `StatusButton("…", status:) { }`. Trigger: Tap / Value change.
- [Glow Border](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/GlowBorder.swift): A rainbow border runs around the view with a soft glow behind it. API: `.glowBorder()`. Trigger: Loop.

## Card & Group

- [Staggered Entrance](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/StaggeredAppear.swift): List items fade and rise into place one after another. API: `.staggeredAppear(index:)`. Trigger: Appear.
- [3D Tilt](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/Tilt.swift): Card tilts in 3D toward the finger with a moving glare, then springs flat. API: `.tiltOnDrag()`. Trigger: Drag.
- [Scroll Reveal](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/ScrollReveal.swift): Rows scale up and come into focus as they enter the visible area. API: `.scrollReveal()`. Trigger: Scroll.
- [Flip Card](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/FlipCard.swift): A two-sided card turns over in 3D with a spring. API: `FlipCard(isFlipped:) { } back: { }`. Trigger: Tap / Value change.
- [Swipe Card Stack](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/SwipeCardStack.swift): Tinder-style deck: drag the top card away and the pile moves up. API: `SwipeCardStack(items) { item in }`. Trigger: Drag.
- [Parallax Carousel](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/ParallaxCarousel.swift): Paging cards whose images slide slower than the cards, for depth. API: `ParallaxCarousel(items) { item in }`. Trigger: Scroll.
- [Expandable Card](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/ExpandableCard.swift): Tap the header and the card springs open, un-blurring its detail. API: `ExpandableCard(isExpanded:) { } detail: { }`. Trigger: Tap.

## Shape

- [Pulse Rings](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/PulseRings.swift): Concentric rings expand and fade continuously, like a radar or live dot. API: `PulseRings()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Like Burst](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/Burst.swift): Particles fly outward from the centre when a value changes. API: `.burst(trigger:)`. Trigger: Tap / Value change.
- [Checkmark Draw](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/AnimatedCheckmark.swift): A success mark draws itself: circle stroke, fill, then a popping check. API: `AnimatedCheckmark(isChecked:)`. Trigger: Value change.
- [Confetti](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/Confetti.swift): Confetti bursts out of the view, tumbles under gravity and fades. API: `.confetti(trigger:)`. Trigger: Tap / Value change.
- [Loaders](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/MotionLoader.swift): Five looping activity indicators: spinner, dots, bars, orbit and pulse. API: `MotionLoader(.spinner)`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Morphing Blob](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/MorphingBlob.swift): An organic, lava-lamp blob whose outline never stops changing. API: `MorphingBlob()`. Trigger: Loop.

## Background

- [Aurora](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Background/AuroraBackground.swift): Soft, blurred colour blobs drift slowly behind your content. API: `AuroraBackground()`. Trigger: Loop.

## Number

- [Rolling Number](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Number/RollingNumber.swift): Digits roll like an odometer when the value changes. API: `RollingNumber(value:)`. Trigger: Value change.

## Particle & 3D

- [Particle Field](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/ParticleField.swift): Drifting particles linked by faint lines, like a living constellation. API: `ParticleField()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Starfield](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/Starfield.swift): Stars stream out of the centre and stretch into streaks: warp speed. API: `Starfield()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Cover Flow](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/CoverFlow.swift): Side items turn away in 3D, shrink and dim; the centre faces you. API: `CoverFlow(items) { item in }`. Trigger: Scroll.
- [Float 3D](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/Float3D.swift): The view hovers: a gentle bob, a slow 3D sway and a breathing shadow. API: `.float3D()`. Trigger: Loop.

## Reference

- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/main/llms-full.txt): usage, implementation notes and full source of every effect
- [motion-catalog.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/main/Docs/motion-catalog.json): the same data as JSON
- [MCP server](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/tree/main/mcp): search effects and fetch their code from any MCP client
